Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the search results and incorrectly identified Geoffrey C. Ward (the writer) as the director of Thomas Jefferson (1997). The DuckDuckGo/Wikipedia snippet clearly stated the film was directed by Ken Burns. This misidentification led to looking up Ward’s birthplace (Newark, Ohio) instead of Ken Burns’s (Brooklyn), producing the wrong final answer.
